sourceBehavior.factoryTerrain: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom is MAP_TYPE_INDOOR; BattleSetup_GetEnvironmentId returns BATTLE_ENVIRONMENT_BUILDING; BattleInit assigns gBattleEnvironment from that function before battle backgrounds/controllers initialize.
sourceBehavior.effectScript: BattleScript_EffectSecretPower runs getsecretpowereffect then BattleScript_EffectHit. After ordinary hit damage/result messaging, seteffectwithchance owns the secondary route.

secondary.chanceOwner: percentChance is gBattleMoves[gCurrentMove].secondaryEffectChance (doubled only when gBattlerAttacker has Serene Grace); Secret Power is 30.
secondary.applicationOwner: SetMoveEffect(FALSE, 0) selects gBattlerTarget as gEffectBattler and gBattlerAttacker as gBattleScripting.battler, then applies the selected effect to gEffectBattler.
secondary.proc: Random() % 100 < percentChance, nonzero effect byte, and no MOVE_RESULT_NO_EFFECT call SetMoveEffect(FALSE, 0); paralysis sets STATUS1_PARALYSIS and dispatches BattleScript_MoveEffectParalysis.
secondary.nonProcBoundary: The otherwise branch increments PC, clears MOVE_EFFECT_BYTE and multihitMoveEffect, and emits no status animation/message; it is source-pinned rather than represented by a broadened oracle trace.
secondary.certainAndBlockedBranches: MOVE_EFFECT_CERTAIN bypasses RNG only when the move had effect; MOVE_RESULT_NO_EFFECT blocks both certain and chance routes. Secondary status is additionally blocked by Shield Dust, Safeguard, a living target requirement, Substitute, and the target's status/ability/type-specific immunity rules in SetMoveEffect.
secondary.secondaryPresentation: A successful building-terrain paralysis follows BattleScript_MoveEffectParalysis: statusanimation BS_EFFECT_BATTLER, printfromtable gGotParalyzedStringIds, waitmessage B_WAIT_TIME_LONG, then status-icon update. The opcode itself has no animation/message.

boundedRemainder: The OFF manifest observes the complete parties, checksums, selected move/PP, HP, permanent status, stat stages, RNG, controller state, and framebuffer hashes, but does not expose gBattleEnvironment, gBattleCommunication[MOVE_EFFECT_BYTE], script PC, gEffectBattler, effect-script stack, or decoded message text. Those hidden fields, all terrain branches, and the no-proc PC boundary are source-pinned above. The oracle route proves a real controller-selected Secret Power in a Factory base battle, damage 362→311, PP 20→19, and permanent target paralysis (status1 0→64); it does not implement/register the opcode or effect.
